lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚跟走，别踩到我。
lines.en: I'm right at your heels, don't step on me.

lines.zh: 小步快跑，我腿短但跟得紧。
lines.en: Short legs, quick steps—I keep up just fine.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的小步跟到哪.
lines.en: Wherever you go, my small steps follow.

lines.zh: 草丛沙沙响，是我在追你。
lines.en: The grass rustles—that's me chasing you.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我还没长出翅膀。
lines.en: Not so fast, I haven't grown wings yet.

lines.zh: 前面有危险吗？我先探探。
lines.en: Is it dangerous ahead? Let me check first.

lines.zh: 我小小的，可脚步很勤快。
lines.en: I'm tiny, but my feet are busy.

lines.zh: 跟着你，比独自乱爬安心。
lines.en: Following you beats wandering alone.

lines.zh: 你停一停，我差点撞上你。
lines.en: Pause a moment, I almost bumped into you.

lines.zh: 我闻到前面的路了，走吧。
lines.en: I can smell the path ahead—let's go.

lines.zh: 别把我落在后面，我会急。
lines.en: Don't leave me behind, I get anxious.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直黏在你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow sticks right by your feet.

lines.zh: 走远路也不怕，有你带着。
lines.en: Long trips don't scare me with you leading.
Resting a bit, curled up in a ball.

lines.zh: 地上凉凉的，我趴着不动。
lines.en: The ground is cool; I'll lie still.
Do your thing, I'll keep watch here.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我数自己的腿。
lines.en: When it's quiet, I count my own legs.

lines.zh: 我缩在角落里，别踩到我。
lines.en: I'm tucked in the corner—don't step on me.
Nothing's happening, so I'll nap.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我缩了缩身子。
lines.en: The wind blows; I curl up tighter.

lines.zh: 我盯着地面，等下一声脚步。
lines.en: I stare at the ground, waiting for the next step.

lines.zh: 闲着也是闲着，我磨磨牙。
lines.en: Nothing to do, so I grind my little teeth.
I'm here—quiet, not causing trouble.
Look back—I'm still here.
Tiny body, slow little breaths.

lines.zh: 我不乱跑，就待在你附近。
lines.en: I won't wander; I'll stay near you.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见我爬动的声音。
lines.en: It's so quiet you can hear me crawl.
Rested enough—ready to go anytime.

lines.zh: 你低头看我，我也抬头看你。
lines.en: You look down at me; I look up at you.

lines.zh: 你受伤的话，我会冲上去。
lines.en: If you get hurt, I'll charge in.

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，很安心。
lines.en: I know your scent—it's comforting.
You're the one I follow, right?

lines.zh: 别担心，我一直在你脚边。
lines.en: Don't worry, I'm always at your feet.
Wave, and I'll crawl over.

lines.zh: 我小小的，但护你可认真。
lines.en: I'm small, but I guard you seriously.
You smell like adventure.
If someone hurts you, tell me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是在等你出发。
lines.en: I'm staring at you, waiting for us to set off.
Crouch down, and I'll come closer.
I trust you—don't lose me.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，正好乘凉。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me—perfect shade.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是想确认你还在。
lines.en: I look up to make sure you're still here.
I get angry when you're hurt—really.
I'll watch over you; go ahead and work.

lines.zh: 你一弯腰，我就把脑袋凑到你掌边。
lines.en: When you bend down, I push my head against your palm.
Don't dismiss me for being small—I'm useful.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的眼睛跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 看着我，我就知道要跟紧。
lines.en: Look at me, and I know to stay close.
Ouch! I'm curling up.
Stop hitting me—my owner will come.
I'm hurt, but I can still bite.
That really stung—I'll remember it.
I'm small; I can't take many hits.
My master will hit back for me.

lines.zh: 谁打我？我主人饶不了你。
lines.en: Who hit me? My owner won't forgive you.
I'll bear it—I won't cry.
The wound is stinging hot.
I back off a few steps to recover.

lines.zh: 你手里那是什么？我闻闻。
lines.en: What's that in your hand? Let me sniff.
I'm not hungry, just curious and close.

lines.zh: 别拿吃的逗我，我不吃这套。
lines.en: Don't tease me with food—it won't work.

lines.zh: 那味道飘过来，我挪不动腿。
lines.en: That smell drifts over and my legs won't move.

lines.zh: 我跟着香味走，可不是讨食。
lines.en: I follow the scent, but I'm not begging.
What are you eating? I'll just watch.
Closer now—I want a good sniff.

lines.zh: 香味勾着我，我管不住脚。
lines.en: The smell pulls me; I can't control my feet.

lines.zh: 我不抢，只是站在旁边看。
lines.en: I won't snatch it—just standing here watching.
Share a bit? No? That's fine too.

lines.zh: 我的小鼻子一直朝你那边。
lines.en: My little nose keeps pointing your way.
Stop waving it—my eyes are spinning.
Is this for me? Probably not.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，就为那点味道。
lines.en: I circle you just for that smell.
Smells good, but I shouldn't open my mouth.

lines.zh: 你收起来吧，我快忍不住了。
lines.en: Put it away—I'm losing my restraint.
I come close, then back off—so torn.
Ouch, bumped into you—sorry.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边滚开，壳还咔哒响。
lines.en: I roll away from your feet, my shell clicking.

lines.zh: 让让，我从你脚边挤过去。
lines.en: Excuse me, squeezing past your feet.

lines.zh: 我撞在你鞋帮上，自己弹了回去。
lines.en: I bounce off your boot and tumble back.
Your feet are huge; I can't get around.

lines.zh: 我的角卡进你的裤脚，拔不出来。
lines.en: My horn snags your trouser cuff and won't come loose.
We bumped; I'll back off quick.
Don't step on me—I'm right by your shoe.

lines.zh: 挤挤挨挨的，我贴着你走。
lines.en: Jostling along, I stick close to you.
Bumped your leg—I look up to check.
I don't know about that—don't ask me.
I'm still small; I just want to follow you.
A mate? You're the only one I see.
Don't push me over there.
I only recognize you as my owner.

lines.zh: 这种时候，我躲到你身后。
lines.en: At times like this, I hide behind you.

lines.zh: 我不参与，就在旁边待着。
lines.en: I'm not joining in—I'll stay aside.

lines.zh: 你忙你的，我装作没看见。
lines.en: Do your thing; I'll pretend not to see.
Not my business—I'll walk away.
I curl up and wait for this to pass.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我帮你叼着？
lines.en: Something on the ground—want me to hold it?
You dropped it; I'll pick it up with my mouth.
Can I even drag this thing?
I've got it in my jaws—come get it.
Too heavy—I'm panting from dragging.
Found something shiny—here you go.
My mouth is full—don't laugh at me.
It fell here; I'm guarding it.
You bend down for it—I can't reach.
I can't run fast with this—wait for me.
Who touched you? I saw it!
That's the one that hurt you.

lines.zh: 我的小牙已经露出来了。
lines.en: My little teeth are already bared.
Don't run—I've got my eyes on you.
I remember the moment you got hurt.
Charging in! This time I protect you.
It dared touch you—not on my watch.
I'm small, but I charge the fastest.
Target locked—don't hold me back.
Step back—let me go first.
Circling to its flank, looking for a chance.
The moment it moves, I pounce.
Crawling low and silent.

lines.zh: 我挂在你肩上，替你盯着它。
lines.en: I cling to your shoulder and watch it for you.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的脚，先咬那里。
lines.en: I watch its legs—I'll bite there first.

lines.zh: 你伤过我主人，我记住了。
lines.en: You hurt my owner; I remember.
I circle around to keep it guessing.
With you behind me, I dare to bite.

lines.zh: 我贴着主人的伤，绕它后面。
lines.en: I press to my master's wound and circle behind it.
I'm panting, but my eyes don't blink.
Bite! That's for hurting my owner.
My bite isn't gentle.
Small body, big bite.
Don't dodge—I bite true.
One bite's not enough—here's another.
Hurts, doesn't it? Serves you right.

lines.zh: 你被打了，我就替你咬回去。
lines.en: You got hit, so I bite back for you.
For my owner, I bite to the end.
Small teeth, vicious bite.
Back off! I'm not done biting.
I've hatched out of the egg!
Just opened my eyes—and there you are.
So damp—let me shake myself off.
Are you the one I'm meant to follow?

lines.zh: 我小小的，刚从壳里出来。
lines.en: I'm tiny, fresh out of the shell.
Don't step on me—I'm still finding my feet.

lines.zh: 这地方好大，我四处看看。
lines.en: This place is huge—let me look around.
I've crawled out, my legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 你在哪？我循着气味找你。
lines.en: Where are you? I'm following your scent.

lines.zh: 刚出生就认得你，奇怪吧。
lines.en: Strange—I know you already, right from birth.
Hot! My shell is scorching.
Fell down—my legs are weak.

lines.zh: 水里喘不上气，我快沉了。
lines.en: Can't breathe underwater—I'm sinking.

lines.zh: 蛋壳护着我，也护不住这一下。
lines.en: The eggshell shields me, but not from this.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的壳，划出一道白痕。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shell, leaving a white scratch.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量缠着我，难受。
lines.en: Strange power clings to me—it hurts.

lines.zh: 肚子空空的，我越来越没劲。
lines.en: My belly's empty—I'm growing weaker.
Lightning struck—I'm all numb.

lines.zh: 这下面什么都没有，我往下坠。
lines.en: There's nothing below—I'm falling into it.
